test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

WIRE : RJWF :: PICK : CJPL :: IMLI : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• First and third letters → Interchanged their positions.
 
• Second and fourth letters → (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• WIRE : RJWF

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/573924c65db8ebe6bae493a5f475a92a947031de8d61b955ee7d89e3785ce666.png] 

And,

 
• PICK : CJPL

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5eacb684723558fd0f60583c8489dd582583f16d25aedd43957d192120de744.png] 

Similarly,

 
• IMLI : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4ef786c77ebf1e3be993ef0fec65e8a48e2710a96ec043743953045e4df8ca2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**LNIJ**".

4f:T
